_purpose: Candidate Elo-1250 -> unified-neutral-points scale rules for schedule-only FCS entities. EXPERIMENTATION ONLY.
_governance: Values here are EXPERIMENTAL and are never canonical.
The FCS rating policy is settled: ruling R2-FCS-ELO-1250 fixes Elo 1250. That is not reopened.
fcs_scale.CANONICAL_FCS_UNIFIED_POINTS stays None; no harness path can set it.
Promotion requires the explicit human token APPROVE_V3_FCS_POINT_SCALE_PROMOTION::<RULING_ID>.
The calibration promotion token is a different namespace and does not authorise this parameter.
This file ships with zero regimes on purpose: authoring a candidate points value would
invent the very calibration the blocker records as missing. Populate it only from an
issued scale rule or a governed calibration program.
Refused by name at authoring time: 0.294, 0.297, 0.297514, the Board equivalent computable
from Elo 1250, and any Elo-layer constant presented as a football-point value.
